name: stave
description: Deterministic cloud security evaluation — 2,650+ controls against configuration snapshots. Air-gapped, no credentials, reproducible verdicts.

modes.local: All tools. Snapshot-touching tools evaluate observation files on the local machine.
modes.hosted: Catalog-query tools only (--hosted or STAVE_MCP_HOSTED=true). Snapshot data never leaves the customer's machine.

tools.name: stave.version
tools.description: Build version + capability counts (controls, packs, frameworks, ATT&CK tactics, formats).

tools.name: stave.search
tools.description: Rank the capability catalog against a free-form intent.

tools.name: stave.catalog_explain
tools.description: Explain one control from the catalog: predicate, required fields, frameworks, severity.

tools.name: stave.explain
tools.description: Explain why one finding fired (reasoning trace, chain membership).

tools.name: stave.suggest_fix
tools.description: One finding's delta paths and catalog-authored remediation.

tools.name: stave.verify
tools.description: Evaluate a snapshot directory; summary | detailed | raw output.

tools.name: stave.dashboard
tools.description: Render an interactive HTML posture dashboard for a snapshot (saved to a file).

tools.name: stave.scorecard
tools.description: Render an interactive HTML compliance scorecard across frameworks (saved to a file).

tools.name: stave.chains
tools.description: Detect compound risk chains and render an interactive HTML chain visualizer (saved to a file).

tools.name: stave.context
tools.description: Drill into one finding, asset, chain, requirement, or framework by {type, id}.

tools.name: stave.diff
tools.description: Structured delta between two snapshot directories.

tools.name: stave.gaps
tools.description: Absent observation fields and the controls each would unlock.

tools.name: stave.readiness
tools.description: Forecast which controls can fire against a snapshot, plus an action plan.
